subject: general
question: Which of the following pairs of numbers is co-prime?
solution:
Concept used:

Co-prime numbers are a set of numbers or integers which have only 1 as their common factor i.e. their highest common factor (HCF) will be 1.

Calculation:

Option 1:

14 = 2 × 7

21 = 3 × 7

Hence, 14 and 21 aren't co-prime.

Option 2:

6 = 2 × 3

35 = 5 × 7

Hence, 6 and 35 are co-prime. 

Since Option 2 suffices as the required answer, there is no need to check any further.

**∴ 6 and 35 of the following pairs of numbers are co-prime.**
